description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Summoning], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Crimson Wildfire Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Summoning
description.text: Summoning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Crimson Wildfire Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Crimson Wildfire after using two Fire abilities

description.name: Crimson Wildfire
description.text: Six single attacks (2.77 each), grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
